name: srt_tools
description: Work with subtitles given as text, SubRip (.srt) or WebVTT (.vtt): parse the cues, shift every time by milliseconds, rescale the times for a frame-rate change (from_fps/to_fps or a factor), convert SRT to VTT and back (tags, entities, NOTE/STYLE blocks and cue settings handled), merge two files in time order, and find overlapping cues. Returns the cues as JSON and the rewritten file.

text.description: The subtitle file; WEBVTT header means WebVTT, else SRT

text2.description: merge: the second file, same format

offset_ms.description: shift: milliseconds to add; merge: shift applied to text2

output.description: Format written; default the input's (convert: the other)

catalog.source: SubRip .srt format as documented by the SubRip/Matroska community; W3C WebVTT: The Web Video Text Tracks Format (Candidate Recommendation) for cues, timestamps, NOTE/STYLE/REGION blocks and escapes
